bug_semantics: Use-after-free of struct udp_tunnel_nic in net/ipv4/udp_tunnel_nic.c. udp_tunnel_nic_device_sync() queue_work()s utn->work and sets utn->work_pending=1 without refusing a second queue while that flag is already set. The workqueue core drops its internal pending bit before invoking udp_tunnel_nic_device_sync_work(); a concurrent RTNL/netlink tunnel or netdev path can then queue the same work again. The still-running worker later does work_pending=0, which also clears the flag for the newly queued instance. udp_tunnel_nic_unregister() treats work_pending==0 as idle and frees utn while the second work item remains queued, so the worker later uses freed offload state.
flaw_origin: cc4e3835eff474aa274d6e1d18f69d9d296d3b76 (Jakub Kicinski, 2020-07-09) first added net/ipv4/udp_tunnel_nic.c. That new file already implemented the unguarded queue_work + work_pending protocol: device_sync queued work without testing work_pending, the worker zeroed work_pending at start, and unregister freed utn when work_pending was 0. Parent 84a4160e5a5951357947ad296932b433de3e34a0 has no such path. 1ead7501094c6a61461c0c98dde9ec5660fa1e24 (2025) later always-queued work after dropping the MAY_SLEEP fast path; that widened the race but did not first-write the vulnerable lines. Linux CNA and the Fixes: tag both name cc4e3835.
evidence: CVE.org CVE-2026-72405 is PUBLISHED (not rejected/withdrawn); GHSA-w888-j23q-c78g withdrawn_at is null. CNA programFiles is net/ipv4/udp_tunnel_nic.c and git ranges start at cc4e3835eff474aa274d6e1d18f69d9d296d3b76. git cat-file -e 84a4160e5a5951357947ad296932b433de3e34a0:net/ipv4/udp_tunnel_nic.c fails; cc4e3835 adds that 821-line file (copyright 2020 Facebook). At first write, udp_tunnel_nic_device_sync queued with `if (may_sleep || utn->need_replay) { queue_work(...); utn->work_pending = 1; }` and never tested work_pending; udp_tunnel_nic_device_sync_work set work_pending=0 after rtnl_lock(); unregister returned early only if work_pending, else freed. git log -S work_pending -- net/ipv4/udp_tunnel_nic.c is cc4e3835, the CVE fix, and later 080695e6 (delayed_work rewrite, post-fix). Mainline fix ecf69d4b43370c587e48d4d70289dbdb7e039d4d (Eric Dumazet; Fixes: cc4e3835eff4) is a 1-line change to `if (!utn->need_sync || utn->work_pending) return;`.
